act: AIFC Collective Investment Scheme Rules (CIS), V8

en.title: AFSA online CIS shows rule 10.1 in the 2018 wording, without Exempt Funds of Foreign Fund Managers added by Amendments No. 2 (2019)
en.summary: The AFSA online CIS still shows 10.1 in the 2018 wording: "This chapter applies to all Funds managed by Fund Managers located in the AIFC." Since Amendments No. 2 (2019), 10.1 also covers (b) Exempt Funds of Foreign Fund Managers. The online text therefore leaves those Funds outside 10.2, 10.3 and 10.6.
en.correction: Please replace rule 10.1 in the online CIS with the current text.
